purpose: Every SharePoint list and library in the NITDA estate, keyed by list GUID, so any GUID a Power Automate definition names resolves to a site and a title without a fresh tenant capture. This is the lookup scripts/flow-list-sweep.mjs resolves against.
derivedFrom: NITDA_SharePoint_Structures_SPOT_20260818.xlsx — "Lists — Full Estate" (326 lists across 5 sites), itself derived from the five per-site tenant metadata exports named in that workbook's "Sources & Provenance".
note: A GUID absent from this index means one of two things, and the sweep says which: the list is on a site never captured, or it was created after 2026-08-18. Neither is a reason to guess — recapture the site.
